hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat) && filepath=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && if [ -n "$filepath" ] && [[ "$filepath" == *.py ]]; then ruff format --quiet "$filepath" 2>/dev/null; ruff check --fix --quiet "$filepath" 2>/dev/null; fi

INPUT=$(cat) && filepath=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && if [ -n "$filepath" ]; then case "$filepath" in *.env|*.env.*|*/.env|*/.env.*) echo 'BLOCKED: Do not edit .env files directly. Use .envrc or ask the user.' >&2; exit 2;; */migration_lock.toml) echo 'BLOCKED: Do not edit Prisma migration lock directly.' >&2; exit 2;; esac; fi
